## Why This Is Asked

This question tests hands-on ability to implement ephemeral, cost-controlled PR sandboxes using core Azure services and Azure DevOps, with proper secret management, feature flags, and observability.

## Key Concepts

- YAML pipelines and PR triggers
- Provisioning sandbox resources (Resource Groups, App Service, Azure SQL)
- Per-PR feature flags via Azure App Configuration
- Secrets management via Azure Key Vault
- Test automation and result publishing
- Automatic teardown on PR close or timeout with cost governance
- Observability via Azure Monitor Logs

## Code Example

```yaml
# Minimal skeleton for PR sandbox pipeline
trigger: none

pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - main

variables:
  azureSubscription: 'Azure-Connection'
  location: 'eastus'
  resourceGroupName: 'pr-sandbox-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  appServiceName: 'prapp-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  sqlDatabaseName: 'prdb-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  appConfigName: 'prconfig-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  keyVaultName: 'prkeyvault-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  costCap: '50'
  retentionHours: 48

stages:
  - stage: Provision
    displayName: 'Provision Resources'
    jobs:
      - job: CreateResources
        displayName: 'Create Sandbox Environment'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create Resource Group'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group create --name $(resourceGroupName) --location $(location)
                az monitor log-analytics workspace create --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --workspace-name pr-sandbox-logs-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create App Service Plan and App Service'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az appservice plan create --name $(appServiceName)-plan --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --sku F1
                az webapp create --name $(appServiceName) --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --plan $(appServiceName)-plan --runtime 'NODE|18-lts'

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create Azure SQL Database'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az sql server create --name prsqlserver$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId) --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --location $(location) --admin-user sqladmin --admin-password $(sqlAdminPassword)
                az sql db create --server prsqlserver$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId) --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --name $(sqlDatabaseName) --service-tier Basic

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create App Configuration'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az appconfig create --name $(appConfigName) --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --location $(location)
                az appconfig kv set --name $(appConfigName) --key FeatureFlags.Enabled --value true --yes
                az appconfig kv set --name $(appConfigName) --key FeatureFlags.NewUI --value false --yes

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create Key Vault'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az keyvault create --name $(keyVaultName) --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --location $(location)
                az keyvault secret set --vault-name $(keyVaultName) --name DatabaseConnectionString --value '$(connectionString)'

          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: 'Retrieve Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsProxy: true

          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            displayName: 'Log to Azure Monitor'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              ResourceGroup: $(resourceGroupName)
              # Add logging configuration

  - stage: Build
    displayName: 'Build and Test'
    dependsOn: Provision
    jobs:
      - job: BuildAndTest
        displayName: 'Build and Run Tests'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            displayName: 'Install Node.js'
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'

          - script: |
              npm install
              npm run build
            displayName: 'Build Application'

          - script: npm run test:unit
            displayName: 'Run Unit Tests'

          - script: npm run test:integration
            displayName: 'Run Integration Tests'

          - task: PublishTestResults@2
            displayName: 'Publish Test Results'
            inputs:
              testResultsFormat: 'JUnit'
              testResultsFiles: '**/test-results.xml'
              failTestsOnFailure: false

  - stage: Teardown
    displayName: 'Teardown Resources'
    condition: or(eq(variables['Build.Reason'], 'PullRequest'), eq(variables['System.PullRequest.PullRequestId'], ''))
    jobs:
      - job: DeleteResources
        displayName: 'Delete Sandbox Environment'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Delete Resource Group'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureSubscription)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group delete --name $(resourceGroupName) --yes --no-wait
```

## Key Considerations

- **Cost Management**: Use F1 (free) tier for App Service, Basic tier for SQL, and set up budget alerts in Azure Cost Management.
- **Naming Convention**: Use PullRequestId in resource names to ensure uniqueness and easy identification.
- **Secrets Handling**: Use Azure Key Vault with Azure DevOps service connections for secure secret retrieval.
- **Timeout Policy**: Implement a scheduled pipeline run or use Azure Functions with timers to enforce the 48-hour cleanup.
- **Observability**: Integrate Azure Monitor for comprehensive logging and alerting.

## Why This Is Asked
This evaluates foundational CI/CD knowledge including pipeline configuration, artifact management, and release governance with security controls.

## Key Concepts
- Azure Pipelines YAML configuration and triggers
- Python environment setup with version 3.11
- Test execution with pytest and coverage reporting
- Wheel package building and artifact publishing
- Release environments with manual approval gates
- Security scanning integration for production deployments

## Code Example
```yaml
# Azure Pipelines YAML for Python CI/CD
trigger:
  - main
pr:
  - main

pool:
  vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'

variables:
  pythonVersion: '3.11'

stages:
- stage: Build
  displayName: 'Build and Test Stage'
  jobs:
  - job: BuildJob
    displayName: 'Build and Test'
    steps:
    - task: UsePythonVersion@0
      inputs:
        versionSpec: '$(pythonVersion)'
      displayName: 'Use Python $(pythonVersion)'
    
    - script: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install pytest pytest-cov
      displayName: 'Install dependencies'
    
    - script: |
        pytest --cov=. --cov-report=xml --cov-report=html
      displayName: 'Run tests with coverage'
    
    - script: |
        python setup.py bdist_wheel
      displayName: 'Build wheel package'
    
    - task: PublishBuildArtifacts@1
      inputs:
        pathToPublish: 'dist'
        artifactName: 'python-wheel'
      displayName: 'Publish wheel artifact'

- stage: Release
  displayName: 'Release to Production'
  dependsOn: Build
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - deployment: DeployToProd
    displayName: 'Deploy to Production'
    environment: 'Production'
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - task: DownloadBuildArtifacts@0
            inputs:
              buildType: 'current'
              downloadType: 'single'
              artifactName: 'python-wheel'
              downloadPath: '$(System.ArtifactsDirectory)'
          
          - task: AntiMalware@3
            inputs:
              InputType: 'Basic'
              ScanDirectory: '$(System.ArtifactsDirectory)/python-wheel'
            displayName: 'Security scan'
          
          - script: |
              echo 'Deploying to production...'
            displayName: 'Deploy to production'
```

## Implementation Notes
- The pipeline triggers on both push and PR to main branch
- Uses Python 3.11 with proper dependency management
- Includes comprehensive testing with pytest and coverage reporting
- Builds and publishes wheel package as build artifact
- Production deployment requires manual approval through environment
- Built-in security scanning (AntiMalware) before production promotion
- Follows Azure DevOps best practices for stage-based deployment

```yaml
trigger: none

parameters:

variables:
  azureServiceConnection: 'azure-spn'
  subscriptionId: '$(AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID)'
  resourceGroupName: 'rg-$(tenantId)'
  appServicePlanName: 'asp-$(tenantId)'
  appServiceName: 'api-$(tenantId)'
  appConfigName: 'appconfig-$(tenantId)'
  keyVaultName: 'kv-shared-01'
  databaseServerName: 'sql-$(tenantId)'
  databaseName: 'db-$(tenantId)'

stages:
  - stage: Provision
    displayName: 'Provision Tenant Resources'
    jobs:
      - job: ProvisionResources
        displayName: 'Provision Infrastructure'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create Resource Group'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group create --name $(resourceGroupName) --location eastus
                az configure --defaults group=$(resourceGroupName)

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create App Service Plan'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create App Service with Deployment Slot'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az webapp create --name $(appServiceName) --plan $(appServicePlanName) --runtime 'NODE|18-lts'
                az webapp deployment slot create --name $(appServiceName) --slot staging

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Create SQL Database'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az sql server create --name $(databaseServerName) --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --location eastus
                az sql db create --name $(databaseName) --server $(databaseServerName) --service-tier Basic

  - stage: Configure
    displayName: 'Configure Tenant'
    dependsOn: Provision
    jobs:
      - job: LoadConfiguration
        displayName: 'Load Settings and Secrets'
        steps:
          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: 'Fetch Tenant Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsPreJob: false

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Configure App Settings'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az webapp config appsettings set --name $(appServiceName) --slot staging --settings \

                  TENANT_DOMAIN=$(tenantDomain) \

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Seed Database'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |

  - stage: Deploy
    displayName: 'Deploy to Staging'
    dependsOn: Configure
    jobs:
      - job: DeployApplication
        displayName: 'Deploy to Staging Slot'
        steps:
          - task: AzureWebApp@1
            displayName: 'Deploy to Staging Slot'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              appType: 'webApp'
              appName: $(appServiceName)
              deployToSlotOrASE: true
              resourceGroupName: $(resourceGroupName)
              slotName: 'staging'

  - stage: Test
    displayName: 'Run Tests'
    dependsOn: Deploy
    jobs:
      - job: RunTests
        displayName: 'Execute Tenant Tests'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Unit Tests'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                npm test -- --tenantId=$(tenantId) --environment=staging

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Integration Tests'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                npm run test:integration -- --tenantId=$(tenantId) --environment=staging

  - stage: GateAndPolicy
    displayName: 'Policy Gates & Drift Check'
    dependsOn: Test
    jobs:
      - job: PolicyCheck
        displayName: 'Verify Policy Compliance'
        steps:
          - task: AzurePolicy@0
            displayName: 'Check Azure Policy Compliance'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              resourceGroupName: $(resourceGroupName)
              definitionId: '/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyDefinitions/...' 

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Drift Detection'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az deployment group show --resource-group $(resourceGroupName) --name initial-deployment
                # Compare current state with desired state

  - stage: Promote
    displayName: 'Promote to Production'
    dependsOn: GateAndPolicy
    condition: succeeded()
    jobs:
      - job: SwapSlots
        displayName: 'Swap Staging to Production'
        steps:
          - task: AzureAppServiceManage@0
            displayName: 'Swap Staging to Production'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              Action: 'Swap Slots'
              WebAppName: $(appServiceName)
              ResourceGroupName: $(resourceGroupName)
              SourceSlot: 'staging'

  - stage: Audit
    displayName: 'Audit & Logging'
    dependsOn: Promote
    jobs:
      - job: LogAuditTrail
        displayName: 'Send Audit Logs to Azure Monitor'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Log Tenant Onboarding'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor app-insights trace show \
                  --location eastus \
                  --query "[?operationName == 'tenant-onboarding']"

                # Send custom event
                az monitor app-insights events show --app $(appInsightsName) --type customEvents
```

```yaml
trigger: main

variables:
  azureServiceConnection: 'azure-sp'
  keyVaultName: 'prod-keyvault'
  appConfigName: 'prod-appconfig'

stages:
  - stage: Validate
    jobs:

        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group deployment validate \
                  --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                  --template-file arm/template.json

      - job: Run_Unit_Tests
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: Python@1
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '3.10'
          - script: pip install pytest
            displayName: 'Install pytest'
          - script: pytest tests/
            displayName: 'Run unit tests'

  - stage: Deploy_Staging
    dependsOn: Validate
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_Staging_Slot
        environment: 'staging'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureKeyVault@2
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
                    SecretsFilter: '*'

                - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    AppConfigurationEndpoint: 'https://$(appConfigName).azconfig.io'
                    KeyValueFilters: 'Environment=Staging'

                - task: AzureResourceGroupDeployment@3
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    resourceGroupName: $(resourceGroup)
                    location: 'eastus'
                    templateFile: 'arm/template.json'
                    parametersFile: 'arm/parameters.staging.json'

                    appType: 'webAppLinux'
```

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design a production-grade data-plane release with real-world constraints: cross-region deployment, canary traffic splits, observability via Log Analytics, policy gating, and irreversible rollback paths.

## Key Concepts
- Canary deployments with traffic shaping via Front Door
- Data-plane upgrade of a Redis shard and shard retirement
- Per-environment secrets from Azure Key Vault
- Compliance and change approvals via Azure Policy gates
- Post-deploy validation using Azure Monitor / Log Analytics and automated rollback

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - main
stages:
  - stage: CanaryUpgrade
    jobs:
      - job: DeployCanary
        steps:
          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            inputs:
              connectedServiceName: 'AZURE_SP'
              keyVaultName: 'kv-${{ parameters.env }}'
              secretsFilter: 'RedisAdminPassword'
          - script: |
              # Create canary shard and apply upgrade
              az redis update --name canary-redis --resource-group rg-${{ parameters.env }} --set version=6.0
          - script: |
              # Route 10% traffic via Front Door
              az front-door routing-rule update --name canary-rule --front-door-name fd-${{ parameters.env }} --set routingRules[0].backendPool=canaryPool
          - task: AzureDiagnostics@1
            inputs:
              query: "Heartbeat | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)"
          - script: |
              echo 'Wait for 24h to validate metrics'
        # conditions for promotion/rollback are implemented in subsequent stages
  - stage: PromoteOrRollback
    dependsOn: CanaryUpgrade
    jobs:
      - job: Evaluate
        steps:
          - script: |
              if [ "$(az monitor metrics retrieve --resource /subscriptions/.../redis.canary --metric latency --aggregation Average)" -lt 100 ]; then
                echo "PROMOTE"
              else
                echo "ROLLBACK"
              fi
        - script: |
            echo 'Execute promotion or rollback actions and audit'
```
